headline: US proposes up to 25% tariffs on India while RBI highlights economic resilience amid global shocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: US proposed tariffs up to 25% on India while offering 17% upon a trade deal.
India rejected US claims of structural excess capacity in a Section 301 probe.
RBI reported that the Indian economy remains resilient with limited oil price shock passthrough.
Tata Steel CEO confirmed working through stakeholder concerns regarding the APL Apollo deal.
whatHappening: US proposed trade tariffs up to 25% on Indian goods, negotiable to 17% under a trade agreement.

Prime Minister Modi reviewed five major projects worth Rs 78,000 crore to reinforce development focus.
